DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。打合せについて何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 設備の打合せに来ました。私の図面は改訂二ですが、机の図面は改訂三です。同じ版にそろえてから話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参図面と打合せ図面の改訂が違うため版をそろえたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come for a meeting about the equipment. My drawing is revision two, but the one on the table is revision three. I'd like us to use the same version before talking.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to align drawing versions because your drawing differs from the meeting drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改訂三が今回の資料です。改訂二のどの部分をご質問になる予定でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Revision three is the material for this meeting. Which parts of revision two were you planning to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配管の位置と点検口の寸法です。旧図面には付箋だけ付けていて、施工指示は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配管と点検口の質問予定で旧図面へ施工指示は書いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: The pipe location and inspection opening dimensions. I've only put sticky notes on the old drawing and haven't written any construction instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned questions about pipes and the inspection opening and did not write construction instructions on the old drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二点を最新版で見ましょう。配管位置は修正されていますが、点検口の寸法は担当者へ照会が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at those two points on the latest version. The pipe location has been revised, but the inspection opening dimensions need to be checked with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旧位置を前提に質問しないよう、配管の付箋を新しい図面へ移します。寸法は未確認として残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配管の付箋を新版へ移し点検口寸法は未確認と記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move the pipe sticky note to the new drawing so I don't ask based on the old position. Please leave the dimensions recorded as unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move the pipe note to the new version and ask for the inspection opening dimensions to be recorded as unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 議事メモに、改訂三で検討し、点検口の寸法は担当確認待ちと書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've written in the meeting notes that we are considering revision three and the inspection opening dimensions are awaiting confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 回答は私だけでなく施工担当にも同じ内容を送ってもらえますか。私から別の数値を伝えるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分と施工担当へ同じ回答を共有してほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you send the same answer to both me and the construction supervisor? I want to avoid passing on a different figure myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the same answer to be shared with both you and the construction supervisor.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。同じ回答を両者に送るよう担当へ依頼します。それまでは寸法変更を確定扱いにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll ask the person responsible to send the same answer to both. Until then, we won't treat the dimension change as finalized.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。改訂三を使い、点検口の寸法と回答共有が未完了だとメモに残して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用版と寸法照会と共有の未完了状態を議事メモへ残すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll take home notes stating that we're using revision three and that checking the inspection opening dimensions and sharing the reply are still incomplete.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the version used and the unfinished dimension inquiry and answer-sharing in the meeting notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認後にご連絡します。本日の打合せはここまでといたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll contact you after checking. That concludes today's meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の取引明細を提出する予定です。携帯の画面を撮ると期間の途中で切れるので、印刷できる方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三か月分の取引画面が切れるため明細印刷の方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm planning to submit my account transaction details. Screenshots on my phone cut off partway through the period, so please tell me how I can print a statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to print transaction details because the screen cuts off the three-month period.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な期間と、提出先が求めている形式はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the required period and the format requested by the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四月一日から六月三十日です。残高だけでなく、期間中の取引が載った資料と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要期間は四月一日から六月三十日で残高だけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: April 1 to June 30. It says they need a document listing transactions during that period, not just the balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the required period is April 1 through June 30 and the requirement is not just the balance.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その指定を見せていただけますか。出力できる範囲と方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show me those instructions? I'll check the available output range and methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。自分で何枚も画面を撮って並べたものでは足りないか、提出先にも確認するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出形式の指定を提示し画面写真でも足りるか提出先へ確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I also plan to ask the recipient whether several screenshots arranged together would be sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the required format and say in Japanese that you will ask the recipient whether screenshots are sufficient too.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。明細の出力方法をご案内します。見せたくない取引がある場合も、原資料は変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We'll explain how to output the statement. Even if some transactions are ones you don't want to show, please don't alter the original document.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の買物を消したいのではなく、口座番号の全桁を出す必要があるか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取引削除ではなく口座番号全桁の提出要否を心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not trying to delete unrelated purchases; I'm concerned about whether I need to show every digit of the account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your concern is not deleting transactions but whether the full account number must be submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点は提出先へ確認してください。銀行が出した原資料と、提出用に加工した物は区別してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that with the recipient. Keep the original document issued by the bank distinct from any edited copy for submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期間全体の原資料を残し、番号を伏せてよいか先に提出先へ聞きます。出力方法の説明をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原資料を残し番号を伏せる許可を提出先へ聞いてから出力方法を教わると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the original covering the entire period, and first ask the recipient whether I may mask the number. Please explain how to output the document.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the original, ask the recipient for permission to mask the number, and learn how to output the document.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の口座を確認して、利用できる出力方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll verify your account and explain the output methods available to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符を買う操作をしましたが、まだ紙が出ません。もう一度買う前に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入操作後に切符が出ず再購入前に係員確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I went through the steps to buy a ticket, but no paper has come out yet. Could you check before I buy another one?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for staff to check before repurchasing because no ticket appeared after the purchase steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用画面は「印刷中」です。追加の購入操作はせず、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This learning screen says “Printing.” Please wait without making another purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 印刷中なのですね。購入に失敗したと思って、最初の画面へ戻ろうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印刷中と理解し購入失敗と思って初期画面へ戻ろうとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's printing. I thought the purchase had failed and was about to return to the first screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand it is printing and had tried returning to the initial screen because you thought the purchase failed.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は結果を確認しましょう。操作を終えた後に、何かボタンを押しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the result now. Did you press any buttons after finishing the steps?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。購入を一回進めた後は触っていません。切符は一人分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分の購入一回後は追加ボタンを押していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. After making one purchase, I haven't touched anything. The ticket is for one person.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that after one purchase for one person you did not press any additional buttons.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかりました。いま受取口へ紙が出ました。ご自身の券を取り、行先と日付を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Paper has now appeared at the collection slot. Please take your ticket and check the destination and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人分の券を受け取りました。ほかに紙が残っていないかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人分の券を受領し受取口のほかの紙も確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've received the ticket for one person. I'd also like to check whether there is any other paper left.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you received a ticket for one person and want to check for other paper in the collection slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取口と画面の案内を一緒に見ましょう。決済について不明な点があれば、担当へ照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's look at the collection slot and screen instructions together. If anything about payment is unclear, we can ask the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券と残る表示を確認し、重複した購入はせず、この一回の結果を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受領券と表示を照合して再購入せず原操作の結果を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the ticket and remaining display, avoid a duplicate purchase, and confirm the result of this one transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the ticket and display, avoid repurchasing, and check the original action's result.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご不明な点は担当へお尋ねください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask the person responsible about anything unclear. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少しだけ演奏を聞きたいです。あの椅子に座ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 演奏を短時間聞きたいと伝え椅子の利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to listen to the performance for a little while. May I sit on that chair?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to listen briefly and ask whether you may use the chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あちらは出演者の機材を置く場所です。観覧用の場所をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is a place for performers' equipment. Are you looking for a viewing area?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。仕事に戻るので、十五分くらいで席を離れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事へ戻るため十五分ほどで退席すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I need to return to work, so I'd like to leave after about fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will leave after about fifteen minutes to return to work.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、観覧区域の端をご案内します。通路は空けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, I'll show you to the edge of the viewing area. Please keep the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 端なら、演奏の途中でもほかの人の前を通らずに出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内された端から他人の前を通らず退出できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: From the edge, can I leave during the performance without passing in front of other people?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can leave from the indicated edge without passing in front of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習用配置では、後ろの通路から出られます。前方のケーブルには近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this practice layout, you can leave via the passage behind. Please don't approach the cables at the front.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。連れも後から来るので、観覧区域の入口で会いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後から来る同行者と観覧区域の入口で会いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My companion is coming later, so I'd like to meet at the viewing-area entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to meet your later-arriving companion at the viewing-area entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口はこちらです。機材を運ぶ通路とは別なので、そちらで合流してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The entrance is here. It is separate from the equipment transport passage, so please meet there.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連れには観覧区域の入口を伝えて、二人で端から静かに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ入口を知らせ二人で端から観覧すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my companion about the viewing-area entrance, and we'll both listen quietly from the edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your companion the entrance and both watch from the edge.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お時間までお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy the performance until you need to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 模型にある大きな建物は、今いる広場に建っていたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 模型の大きな建物と現在の広場の位置関係を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Did the large building in the model stand on the plaza where we are now?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the position of the model's large building relative to the present plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 模型の向きをまず合わせましょう。模型の入口はどちらを向いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's align our orientation with the model. Which way is the model's entrance facing?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口はこちら側ですね。私は反対向きに見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の向きを読み自分が反対向きに見ていたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The entrance is on this side. I was looking at it the other way round.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the entrance orientation and correct yourself in Japanese that you were looking from the opposite direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では模型を回さず、見る位置をこちらへ移しましょう。この印が現在地です。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's move to look from here rather than turning the model. This mark shows our current location.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現在地の印と建物の位置は少し離れていますね。その間は何の場所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在地と建物の間の場所について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The current-location mark is a little away from the building. What was the area between them?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the space between the current location and the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この学習用模型では庭として示されています。建物と庭の境目はこの線です。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this learning model, it is shown as a garden. This line is the boundary between the building and garden.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 庭の線をメモしたいです。模型に触らず指で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 模型に触れず庭の境界を示してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to note the garden boundary. Could you point it out without touching the model?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the garden boundary to be indicated without touching the model.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。現在の広場の形を、そのまま昔の建物の形とは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, here it is. Please don't assume the present plaza's shape is exactly the shape of the former building.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 建物と庭を分けて描き、現在地には別の印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物と庭を分けて描き現在地を別の印で記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll draw the building and garden separately and use a different mark for our current location.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will draw the building and garden separately and record the current location with a separate mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その整理で見比べられますね。どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should help you compare them. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご案内できることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この屋根の下の模様は、誰かの名前が書いてあるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 屋根の下の模様が人名の表記か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are the patterns under this roof someone's name written out?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the patterns under the roof are a person's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分でしょうか。繰り返している丸い図案を指していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part do you mean? Are you referring to the repeated round designs?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、その丸い部分です。文字だと思って読もうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸い図案を文字と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, those round parts. I thought they were writing and was trying to read them.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the round designs were written characters.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの学習用説明では装飾の図案とされています。人名の表記はこちらの説明札にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This learning explanation identifies them as decorative designs. The person's name is written on this explanatory label.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図案と人名は別なのですね。図案の向きも全部同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人名との違いを確認し図案の向きを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the designs and person's name are separate. Are all the designs facing the same direction too?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the distinction from the person's name and ask in Japanese about the designs' orientation.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見える範囲で比べてみましょう。中央と端では向きが違うように描かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare what we can see. The ones in the middle and at the ends are drawn as if they face different directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真よりスケッチで残したいです。通路をふさがない場所で描けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路をふさがずスケッチできる場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to sketch them rather than take a photo. Is there somewhere I can draw without blocking the walkway?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for somewhere to sketch without blocking the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの待機用スペースを使ってください。見えない部分まで推測して描く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this waiting space. You don't need to guess and draw parts you can't see.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見える丸い図案だけを描いて、人名は説明札から別にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見える図案を描き人名を説明札から別に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll draw only the visible round designs and note the person's name separately from the explanatory label.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will draw the visible designs and separately copy the name from the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。足元にも気をつけて、ごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please watch your step too, and enjoy looking around.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待合室でこの袋を見つけました。忘れ物として預かってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合室で拾った袋を忘れ物として受付へ預けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found this bag in the waiting room. Could you take it as a lost item?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to leave a bag found in the waiting room at reception as lost property.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。診察に来られたご本人のお荷物ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. It isn't your own bag as a patient here, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私は付き添いで、この袋の持ち主は知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 付き添いであり袋の所有者を知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I'm accompanying someone, and I don't know who owns this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are accompanying someone and do not know the bag's owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。どのあたりに置いてありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓側の椅子の下です。隣にいた方の物かと思いましたが、その方も違うと言いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋があった椅子の位置と隣の人へ確認した経緯を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Under the chairs by the window. I thought it might belong to the person beside it, but they said it wasn't theirs either.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese the chair's location and how you checked with the neighboring person.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を記録します。中身はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the location. Have you looked inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、中は開けていません。袋の口は閉じたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身を開けず袋の口が閉じた状態だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I haven't opened it. The bag's opening is still closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not opened it and the bag remains closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態でお預かりします。持ち主の確認は職員が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take it in that condition. Staff will check who owns it.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。私は連れの待合席に戻りますので、袋はここに置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を受付へ渡し同行者の待合席へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll go back to my companion's waiting-room seat, so I'll leave the bag here.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hand the bag to reception and return to your companion's seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受け取りました。お知らせくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received it. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道に袋が置かれていたので写真を撮りました。ただ、カメラの時計がずれていたことを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 道の袋を撮影したが機器時計にずれがあると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I photographed a bag left on the road. However, I want to explain that the camera's clock was incorrect.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you photographed a bag on the road but the device clock was inaccurate.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影した表示時刻と、実際に見たと思う時刻を分けて伺います。写真を撮ったのはご本人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask separately about the time displayed on the photo and the time you believe you actually saw it. Did you take the photograph yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。表示は午後五時ですが、その後カメラが二時間進んでいると気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人撮影で表示五時だが時計が二時間進んでいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It shows five p.m., but afterwards I realized the camera was two hours fast.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you took the photo and it displays five, but the clock was two hours fast.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の表示はそのまま残してください。実際の時刻を確かめられる記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the original display unchanged. Do you have any records that could help establish the actual time?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰宅前に店で買った控えがあります。写真の前に寄った店で、控えは午後二時四十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影前の買物控え二時四十分を別の行動記録として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a receipt from shopping before going home. I stopped at the shop before taking the photo, and the receipt says two forty p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the two-forty shopping receipt as a separate record of an activity before the photo in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それは前の行動の記録ですね。写真を撮るまでの時間は正確にわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That records an earlier activity. Do you know exactly how much time passed before you took the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正確にはわかりません。三時ごろだと思いますが、写真の時刻を自分で書き換えてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正確な経過は不明で三時頃は推定かつ元画像未改変と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not exactly. I think it was around three, but I haven't changed the photograph's time myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the exact elapsed time is unknown, around three is an estimate, and the original image is unaltered.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 推定と機器の表示を別々に記録します。袋を置いた人は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record the estimate separately from the device's display. Did you see who left the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見ていません。元の写真と時計のずれ、前の買物記録を示し、捨てた人や正確な時刻は断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影元情報と時計ずれと前行動記録を分け投棄者時刻は断定しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I'll show the original photograph, the clock error and the earlier shopping record, without claiming who discarded it or the exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the original photo information, clock error and earlier activity record, without asserting who left it or the exact time.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご説明ありがとうございます。資料は担当へ引き継ぎますので、案内した場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining. We'll pass the materials to the person responsible, so please wait in the place indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything I can help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この靴を試したら、右足だけきついです。別のサイズも試せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試着靴で右だけ窮屈だと伝え別サイズを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I tried on these shoes, only the right foot felt tight. May I try another size too?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only the right shoe feels tight and ask for another size.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左右の内側の表示を見てもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I look at the labels inside both shoes?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どうぞ。棚の二足を見比べていて、片方ずつ履いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚の二足から左右を混ぜて試着したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I was comparing two pairs on the shelf and put on one from each pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mixed the left and right shoes from two pairs on the shelf while trying them on.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右は二十四センチ、左は二十四・五センチです。まず同じサイズでそろえましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The right is 24 centimetres and the left is 24.5. First, let's make them the same size.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら二十四・五センチの左右をお願いします。右がきつかった理由を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二十四・五センチの同じ組で右足を試し直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please give me both shoes in 24.5. I'd like to check why the right one felt tight.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to try the right foot again with a matching pair in size 24.5.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが同じサイズの一組です。立って足先の余裕も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is a pair in the same size. Please stand and check the space around your toes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今度は右も痛くありません。少し歩いて、かかとが抜けないか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 痛みが消えたと伝え歩いてかかとの状態を確かめたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This time my right foot doesn't hurt either. I'd like to walk a little and check whether my heels slip out.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the pain is gone and ask to walk and check the heels.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この試着用の範囲で歩けます。見本の靴は、こちらで組を元に戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can walk within this fitting area. We'll put the display shoes back into their correct pairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩いてもかかとは抜けませんでした。この一組を候補にして、色も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行時に抜けなかったと報告し候補サイズの色違いを見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My heels didn't slip when walking. I'll keep this pair as a candidate; please also show me the colors.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the heels did not slip when walking and ask for other colors in the candidate size.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。候補のサイズを控えます。どうぞごゆっくりお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll note the size you're considering. Please take your time choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白菜を買いたいです。家にフライパンしかありませんが、炒め物にも使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: フライパンしかないため白菜を炒め物に使えるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy Chinese cabbage. I only have a frying pan at home; can I use it for a stir-fry too?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can stir-fry Chinese cabbage because you only have a frying pan.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 炒め物にも使えますよ。何人分作るご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, you can stir-fry it too. How many people are you cooking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人分です。丸ごと一つ買うと、使い切るのが難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人分で丸ごとは使い切りにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just one. I think it would be difficult to use up a whole head.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are cooking for one and a whole head would be hard to finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この売場では、四分の一に切った物も並べています。重さも見て比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also sell quarter heads here. You can compare their weights too.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四分の一を選びます。芯の厚い所と葉は、一緒に炒めていいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四分の一を選び芯と葉を一緒に炒めるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose a quarter. Can I stir-fry the thick stalk and leaves together?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a quarter head in Japanese and ask whether to cook the stalk and leaves together.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 芯は葉より火が通るのに時間がかかります。芯を薄く切ると使いやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The stalk takes longer to cook than the leaves. Slicing it thinly makes it easier to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず芯を薄く切って、葉は後で加えるということですね。残りは切らずに置いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 芯を先に薄く切り葉を後で加える理解と残りを切らない希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should slice the stalk thinly first and add the leaves later. I'd like to leave the rest uncut.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand to slice the stalk first and add leaves later, and want to keep the remainder uncut.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残す分は商品の保存表示を確かめてください。切った面が乾かないよう包む方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the product's storage instructions for the remaining portion. One option is to wrap it so the cut surface does not dry out.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今晩使う分だけ切ります。この四分の一を一つください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今晩使う分だけ切ると決め四分の一の白菜を購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll cut only what I use tonight. One of these quarter heads, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to cut only tonight's portion and buy one quarter head of Chinese cabbage.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらをお包みします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I'll wrap this for you. Thank you.
